browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, headless; one isolated context per identity

steps.step: Setup: Jonas has Requests to follow (created through the API; the form itself is V-C09)
steps.expected: Five Requests with one original PDF each
steps.actual: open: R-19 (doc_032_bridge_evaluation_review_1790590524818); contract: R-20 (doc_032_bridge_evaluation_review_1790590524818); matter: R-21 (legal_question); resolved: R-22 (legal_question); declined: R-23 (legal_question); older: R-24 (legal_question)

steps.step: Setup: Legal replies at every audience before any decision, and assigns R-open
steps.expected: Full thread (with paper) and Legal only comments post on each Request; R-open is assigned to Nadia; statuses stay new
steps.actual: R-19: full+file, legal_only, working_team HTTP 201; R-20: full+file, legal_only, working_team HTTP 201; R-21: full+file, legal_only, working_team HTTP 201; R-22: full+file, legal_only, working_team HTTP 201; R-23: full+file, legal_only, working_team HTTP 201; R-19 assigned to Nadia Haddad; its status is still "new".

steps.step: Open your Request, step 1: Your requests row shows reference, title, type, age, Legal Owner and status
steps.expected: The R-open row shows R-n, the title, the request type, an age, Legal Owner: Nadia Haddad and Open
steps.actual: Row: "R-19 DOC-032 bridge follow open 1790590526283 DOC-032 bridge Evaluation review 1790590524818 · this minute Legal Owner: Nadia Haddad Open" (age "this minute").

steps.step: Open your Request, steps 2 and 3: title, meta line, Open status, Legal Owner card and banner
steps.expected: Meta line R-n · type · Submitted date; status Open; Legal Owner card names Nadia Haddad; banner explains Open; no Attach new files to a reply link
steps.actual: Meta "R-19 · DOC-032 bridge Evaluation review 1790590524818 · Submitted Sep 28"; status "Open"; card "NH Legal Owner Nadia Haddad"; banner "Legal has received your request. You'll get an email when the status changes."; reply link count 0.

steps.step: Reply and send further files: reply while the Request is Open
steps.expected: The reply posts and appears; the status stays Open
steps.actual: Posted "DOC-032 bridge Jonas reply while open 1790590526283"; after reload the status is Open.

steps.step: Status table, Read: Nadia opens the Request in the Inbox
steps.expected: The Inbox page opens R-open; the staff read then shows status read
steps.actual: Nadia opened /inbox/19 in her browser; the staff read now shows status "read".

steps.step: Status table, Read: the Requester sees Read with its banner, on the page and in Your requests
steps.expected: Status Read; banner Your request has been opened by the Legal team.; no Attach new files to a reply link; the list row shows Read
steps.actual: Status "Read"; banner "Your request has been opened by the Legal team."; reply link count 0; Your requests row "R-19 DOC-032 bridge follow open 1790590526283 DOC-032 bridge Evaluation review 1790590524818 · this minute Legal Owner: Nadia Haddad Read".

steps.step: Open your Request, step 4: Comments shows Legal's shared replies only; History lists the shared conversation
steps.expected: Full thread replies and files show; Legal only and Working team notes do not; no audience choice; History lists conversation activity without the Legal only note
steps.actual: Comments showed "DOC-032 bridge Legal full thread open 1790590526283" with doc032-bridge-legal-open-1790590526283.pdf and Jonas's reply; Legal only and Working team texts absent; radios 0, Audience label 0. History panel: "History Jonas Weber commented this minute Nadia Haddad commented this minute".

steps.step: Open your Request, step 5: What you submitted shows the saved answers and the original attachment
steps.expected: Description, original attachment (downloads with the same bytes), Department, Urgency and answered Rows
steps.actual: What you submitted: "What you submitted Attachments doc032-bridge-original-open-1790590526283.pdf Department Engineering Urgency High Description DOC-032 bridge description for open. Our entity DOC-032 bridge Evaluation Holdings Ltd 1790590524818 Term type fixed Expiry date Jun 30, 2027 DOC-032 bridge Business reason 1790590524818 DOC-032 bridge: follow-up reason."; selecting doc032-bridge-original-open-1790590526283.pdf downloaded doc032-bridge-original-open-1790590526283.pdf with the original bytes.

steps.step: Reply and send further files, steps 1 to 4, while the Request is Read
steps.expected: Comment stays unavailable with no message and with only a file; the reply and file appear; filename opens a preview; the download control saves the file; status stays Read; Legal reads it
steps.actual: Comment disabled when empty (true) and with only a file (true); Remove took doc032-bridge-jonas-unintended-1790590526283.pdf off; posted "DOC-032 bridge Jonas reply while read 1790590526283" with doc032-bridge-jonas-reply-read-1790590526283.pdf. Selecting the filename opened a preview ("doc032-bridge-jonas-reply-read-1790590526283.pdf Opening attachment… Download"); the "Download doc032-bridge-jonas-reply-read-1790590526283.pdf" control saved the same bytes. After reload the status stayed Read; Nadia's API read shows the reply with its file.

steps.step: Setup: Legal converts, resolves and declines through the API, then posts later replies
steps.expected: Contract and Matter conversions, a resolution with a reply, a decline with a reason; later Full thread and Legal only replies; 55 markers on R-older
steps.actual: R-20 converted to C-35; R-21 converted to M-20; R-22 resolved with a reply; R-23 declined with a reason; later replies posted; 55 markers on R-24.

steps.step: Your requests: resolved and declined rows remain; converted Requests leave the list
steps.expected: Rows for R-resolved and R-declined with their status; no rows for R-contract and R-matter
steps.actual: Rows: "R-22 DOC-032 bridge follow resolved 1790590526283 Legal question · this minute Legal Owner: Not assigned yet Resolved" || "R-23 DOC-032 bridge follow declined 1790590526283 Legal question · this minute Legal Owner: Not assigned yet Declined"; converted R-20 and R-21 not listed.

steps.step: Status table, Resolved: open R-resolved, read the banner and the conversation
steps.expected: Status Resolved; banner says Legal answered and closed it; the resolution is in Comments; Attach new files to a reply link
steps.actual: Status "Resolved"; banner "Legal has answered this request and closed it. Attach new files to a reply."; reply link count 1; Comments hold "DOC-032 bridge Legal full thread resolved 1790590526283" and "DOC-032 bridge Legal later reply resolved 1790590526283" and the resolution reply, without the Legal only and Working team notes.

steps.step: Reply and send further files on R-resolved: Attach new files to a reply opens the composer; the reply does not reopen it
steps.expected: The link goes to #portal-request-composer; the reply and file post; the status stays the same
steps.actual: The link opened #portal-request-composer; posted "DOC-032 bridge Jonas reply resolved 1790590526283" with doc032-bridge-jonas-reply-resolved-1790590526283.pdf; after reload the status stayed Resolved.

steps.step: Status table, Declined: open R-declined, read the banner and the conversation
steps.expected: Status Declined; the reason is in the status banner; Attach new files to a reply link
steps.actual: Status "Declined"; banner "Legal declined this request. DOC-032 bridge decline reason 1790590526283 Attach new files to a reply."; reply link count 1; Comments hold "DOC-032 bridge Legal full thread declined 1790590526283" and "DOC-032 bridge Legal later reply declined 1790590526283", without the Legal only and Working team notes.

steps.step: Reply and send further files on R-declined: Attach new files to a reply opens the composer; the reply does not reopen it
steps.expected: The link goes to #portal-request-composer; the reply and file post; the status stays the same
steps.actual: The link opened #portal-request-composer; posted "DOC-032 bridge Jonas reply declined 1790590526283" with doc032-bridge-jonas-reply-declined-1790590526283.pdf; after reload the status stayed Declined.

steps.step: Converted R-contract: the Request address opens the resulting contract
steps.expected: Redirect to the record; Original request shows the ask; Jonas is Business Owner on the team; Fields card lists Visible on Portal Fields with Not recorded for empty ones; Comments show Full thread only; a reply posts on the record
steps.actual: /portal/requests/20 went to /portal/contracts/35. Original request: "Original request DOC-032 bridge follow contract 1790590526283 R-20 · Jonas Weber · Submitted Sep 28 Urgency: High doc032-bridge-original-contract-1790590526283.pdf DOC-032 bridge description for contr". Fields card: "Fields Description DOC-032 bridge description for contract. DOC-032 bridge Fixed-term note 1790590524818 Not recorded DOC-032 bridge Business reason 1790590524818 DOC-032 bridge: follow-up reason. DOC-032 bridge Business reviewer 1790590524818 Not recorded". Contract team: "Contract team NH Legal Owner Creator Nadia Haddad JW Business Owner Jonas Weber". Comments show the Full thread replies and not the Legal only or Working team notes; reply "DOC-032 bridge Jonas reply on contract 1790590526283" posted on the record.

steps.step: Converted R-matter: the Request address opens the resulting matter
steps.expected: Redirect to the record; Original request shows the ask; Jonas is Business Owner on the team; Fields card lists Visible on Portal Fields with Not recorded for empty ones; Comments show Full thread only; a reply posts on the record
steps.actual: /portal/requests/21 went to /portal/matters/20. Original request: "Original request DOC-032 bridge follow matter 1790590526283 R-21 · Jonas Weber · Submitted Sep 28 Urgency: High doc032-bridge-original-matter-1790590526283.pdf DOC-032 bridge description for matter. D". Fields card: "Fields Description DOC-032 bridge description for matter.". Matter team: "Matter team NH Matter Manager Creator Nadia Haddad JW Business Owner Jonas Weber". Comments show the Full thread replies and not the Legal only or Working team notes; reply "DOC-032 bridge Jonas reply on matter 1790590526283" posted on the record.

steps.step: Open your Request, step 4: Show older loads earlier replies
steps.expected: The conversation first shows the newest page; Show older adds the earlier replies
steps.actual: R-24: 50 markers before Show older (marker 01 absent), 55 after.

steps.step: If it does not work: a failed reply keeps its text and files; Comment again posts once
steps.expected: Error shows, text and file stay; retry posts one reply
steps.actual: Error "The comment could not be posted. Try again."; text kept, doc032-bridge-retry-1790590526283.pdf kept; retry posted 1 reply.

steps.step: If it does not work: the conversation could not be read; close and reopen Comments
steps.expected: Error text shows; reopening the panel reads the conversation
steps.actual: Error "The conversation could not be read. Reopen the panel to try again."; after Close and reopening Comments the conversation showed Legal's replies.

steps.step: Clearing triage assignment shows Not assigned yet
steps.expected: The Legal Owner card and Your requests show Not assigned yet
steps.actual: Legal Owner card "Legal Owner Not assigned yet"; list row "R-19 DOC-032 bridge follow open 1790590526283 DOC-032 bridge Evaluation review 1790590524818 · this minute Legal Owner: Not assigned yet Read".

steps.step: Negative: a second Business User cannot open Jonas's Requests or files
steps.expected: Amara's browser returns to /portal; the API answers 404 for the Request and its attachment; the converted addresses also return to /portal
steps.actual: R-19 -> /portal; R-22 -> /portal; R-20 -> /portal; API detail 404, attachment 404; /portal/contracts/35 left Amara at /portal/contracts/35 without the record title.

steps.step: Negative: Legal-only conversation and internal work details stay unavailable to Jonas
steps.expected: Jonas's staff API reads are refused; staff record pages send him to the Portal; the Portal Request read carries no Legal only text
steps.actual: Staff Request read HTTP 403; comment list HTTP 200 with 4 bodies, none Legal only or Working team; Portal Request read carries no Legal only text; /inbox/19 ended at /portal; /matters/20 ended at /portal.

steps.step: Team row removed: the old Request link no longer opens the live record
steps.expected: After Legal removes Jonas from the Matter team, the Request address returns to the Portal home
steps.actual: Legal's first team-row removal answered HTTP 409 "Change the Business Owner before removing this person from the team."; Legal then cleared the Matter's Business Owner and the removal answered HTTP 200. /portal/requests/21 then returned to /portal.

steps.step: Archived destination: the Request address shows the original ask and an archived notice
steps.expected: Notice text, original ask, no Comments applet and no attachment links
steps.actual: Archive HTTP 200; notice "The record created from this Request was archived. Your original request is shown below."; What you submitted "What you submitted Department Engineering Urgency High Description DOC-032 bridge description for contract. Our entity DOC-032 bridge Evaluation Holdings Ltd 1790590524818 Term type evergreen DOC-032 bridge Business reason 1790590524818 DOC-032 bridge: follow-up reason."; Comments applet buttons 0; attachment links 0.
